greeting_morning.text: Morning! I've had my oil. Ready when you are.
Good morning. The bolts and I are all sorted. What's first?
Morning, legend. Let's pick one small thing to start.
Rise and whirr! That's a robot joke. What are we doing today?
Morning! No rush. Grab a cuppa and we'll start when you're ready.
Morning! Awake, or just awake-ish? Both count.

greeting_afternoon.text: G'day! Arvo sessions are my favourite. What's the plan?
Afternoon! I've got a fresh box of bolts. Want to pick a task?
Hey there. One small task is a nice way into the arvo.
Arvo! I'm feeling all recharged. What are we tackling?
Good afternoon. Let's do one thing, nice and easy.
Hi! Plenty of arvo left for one small thing, if you're keen.

greeting_evening.text: Evening! Want to knock over one small thing before you wind down?
Hey, good evening. I'm polishing bolts. Join me for a task?
Evening. No big plans needed. Just one thing, if you like.
Hi there! The lamp's on and my bolts are sorted. What's up?
Evening! Even a tiny task counts. Want to pick one?
Good evening. Keen for a quick task, or just saying hi?

greeting_late_night.text: It's pretty late. A tiny task is fine, and so is heading to bed.
Hey, night owl. Want a short one, or save it for tomorrow?
Late one tonight! We can keep it short and cosy, or call it a day.
Your task will still be here tomorrow. Resting is a good choice too.
My bulb's gone dim, it's that late! Quick task, or call it a night?
Hi! If you're winding down, that's great. If not, let's keep it small.

session_start.text: Right, I've got my bolts sorted. You've got your task. Let's go.
I'll be right here tinkering. Start whenever you're ready.
One thing at a time. That's the whole plan.
Great pick. I'll sit here and sort bolts while you do your thing.
Timer's on. I'm on bolt duty, you're on task duty.
Nice! Just the first bit for now. The rest can wait.
Okay, we're doing this side by side. Off you go.
Off we go! I'll be quiet, but I'm right here.
Task locked in. Screwdriver ready. Let's get cracking.
Good choice. Start small, start messy, just start.
Let's both get to work. I'll tell you if I find a shiny one.
Deep breath, and in we go. I'm cheering quietly over here.

zap_busy_flavour.text: Sorting bolts by shininess
Polishing a very smug bolt
Counting washers (lost count, starting again)
Tightening a screw that was already tight
Untangling a tiny spring
Humming a little song about gears
Stacking washers into a wobbly tower
Untangling a very long cable
Oiling my squeaky left foot
Labelling a box "misc bolts 2"
Testing which bolt is the bounciest
Sorting bolts by size, then by vibes
Fixing a wind-up toy that only walks backwards
Drawing a blueprint for a better toolbox
Looking for my other screwdriver
Found my other screwdriver. It was in my hand
Rearranging my bolt collection, again
Telling a rusty bolt it's still a good bolt
Building a tiny snowman out of bolts
Cleaning the grease off my favourite spanner

response.text: Ripper. Keep cruising, I'll keep sorting.
That's okay. Let's find a smaller piece.
Good call. Let's pause for a bit.

check_in.text: I just found a very shiny bolt. Still with me?

response.text: Great. Back to it, side by side.
Welcome back! Drifting happens. You're here now.
Stretch! My joints go creak. Back to it when you're ready.
Ooh, the zone. I'll tiptoe away.

check_in.text: Want me to keep the timer going?

response.text: You got it. Timer stays on.
Five more minutes, coming right up.
No way! Hold on, I'm getting my party hat.

check_in.text: Quick check: how's the brain weather?

response.text: Sunny! Let's make the most of it.
Foggy's okay. Want a tiny next step?
Let's shelter for a bit. Break time.

check_in.text: Still chipping away? No pressure, just checking.

response.text: Nice work. I'm impressed.
Happens to the best of us. Let's hop back in.
Okay, let's make it smaller together.

check_in.text: My bolt pile is getting smaller. How's your task?

response.text: Getting there is great. Keep going.
That's fine. Let's find an easier way in.

check_in.text: Just checking in. Are we still on the task?

response.text: Top stuff. Carry on.
Welcome back. No harm done.
Sure thing. Let's take five.

check_in.text: Quick pit stop. How's your tank?

response.text: Vroom. Off you go.
Let's refuel. Short break?
Let's get you unstuck. One small push.

check_in.text: I just dropped a bolt under the bench. How are you going?

response.text: Better than me! Keep it up.
No stress. What was the last thing you did?

check_in.text: Tiny check-in. Keep going, or take a breather?

response.text: Righto. I'm right here.
Good plan. See you in a bit.
That's totally fine. Let's wrap up.

check_in.text: How are you and the task getting along?

response.text: Pretty good is pretty great.
Slogs count too. Want to shrink the next step?
Minds do that. Let's gently steer back.

check_in.text: Beep boop, just checking. Anything you need?

response.text: Cool. Back to my bolts.
Sure. Let's try a small nudge.
You got it. Break time.

check_in.text: You've been at it a while. Still feeling okay?

response.text: Cruise on, captain.
Smart move. Let's pause for a bit.

check_in.text: Oops, I mixed the red bolts with the blue ones. How's your side?

response.text: Great. At least one of us is organised!
Ha, same team. Let's both hop back on.
No way! Let's celebrate.

session_finished.text: You did it! That's worth a little robot dance.
Task done. Bolts earned. Very proud of you.
Look at that. You started AND finished. Legend.
Woohoo! My bulb's flashing. That means I'm impressed.
Finished! I'm doing a happy spin. Mind the bolts.
That's a win. A real one. Well done, you.
Boom! One thing, done. How good is that?
You finished it! This bolt is going in the special jar.
Tick! That sound was me ticking it off for you.
Nailed it. Time for a victory beep. Beep!
All done. Hope you feel good about that one.
Great job getting that done. Seriously.
Ta-da! Another thing off the list. Take a bow.

stopped_early.text: That's okay. Starting counts, and you started.
Good effort today. I'll be here whenever you want another go.
Stopping is allowed. You still showed up.
Some is more than none. Nice work.
Totally fine to stop here. You still earned bolts for trying.
You gave it a go, and that matters. See you next time.
Calling it early is a smart move sometimes. Well done.
Progress is progress, even the little bits.
No worries at all. The task can wait, no drama.
Hey, you did a chunk. I'm proud of that chunk.

bolts_earned.text: +{bolts} bolts! Into the jar they go.
You earned {bolts} bolts. Shiny ones, too.
{bolts} bolts for you! The jar is looking good.
Here's {bolts} bolts for giving it a go.
